newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Hansapank to sell Savings stake.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Hansapank to sell Savings stake.

text.p: Estonia's largest bank Hansapank is to sell its 21 percent stake in the country's second largest bank, Savings Bank, Hansapank officials said on Wednesday.
Juri Mois, chief executive officer of Hansapank, confirmed a report in newspaper Aripaev and said the shares would probably be sold next year.
"The Savings Bank share price is healthy and our position is that when it is healthy we will sell it," he told Reuters in an interview.
Aripaev said the bank would make 89.7 million kroons extraordinary profit on the deal.
Mois said Hansapank was growing rapidly but its share capital was not big enough. The sale of the Savings Bank stake would help fund its development, he added.
Hansapank has been developing fast to become the leading bank in Estonia. It has also expanded into Latvia by buying the former German-Latvian bank.
